text:
Alex: Heads up — planning a release in tonight's change window at 23:00 UTC. This touches API header-routing toggle + runtime kernel selection (batching/kernel). Need coord across api/runtime/console/router. Primary rollback gate: 5xx rate > 0.8% OR tail p99 > 1s sustained for 3m. Canary starts at 2%.

Maria: Got it. I'll freeze console schema push until we say go. Which runtime binary are we pinning?

Alex: Pin runtime to rtx-2.3.1-quant for canary; fallback rtx-2.2.9 if we see perf regressions. Router needs header split flag enabled. We'll do api+runtime first, router next, console last.

Sam: I can do the router flip. Which header key + flag name?

Alex: header: X-RD-Route -> value `v2-kern`. Flag: `route-header-split`. @deploy-bot schedule waves: wave1=api+runtime, wave2=router, wave3=console.

deploy-bot: Scheduling canary waves:
- wave1: api, runtime @ 23:00 UTC (2% traffic)
- wave2: router @ 23:10 UTC (2%)
- wave3: console @ 23:20 UTC (2%)
Commands for wave1:
```
/deploy create --service api --image api:release-2026-03 --wave 1
/deploy create --service runtime --image runtime:rtx-2.3.1-quant --wave 1
```

Lina: For rollback safety, if console schema migration fails we hold router full rollout. I'll add a migration toggle and a one-click unpin for runtime.

Ira: Telemetry question — will metric names change? Need dashboards updated before full rollout.

Maria: Yes — `api.request.router_version` becomes `api.request.route_variant`. I'll open a grafana PR and link it.

Sam: Router config snippet for the header split in staging:
```
route_split:
  - header: X-RD-Route
    variants:
      - v1: 98
      - v2-kern: 2
```

Alex: Short release notes (draft):
- kernel selection optimization (rtx-2.3.1-quant)
- header-based routing to gradually deploy kernel variants
- console: schema v5 behind a toggle (backwards-compatible)
Rollback plan: immediate runtime unpin + revert header split to v1 if gating metrics breach.

Lina: I'll add explicit rollback commands to the runbook and a quick checklist for oncall.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks: 
- service deps: api -> runtime OK
- kernel artifact checksum matches
- capacity: dedicated GPU pools available
All preflight checks PASS.

Sam: Starting dry-run at 22:30 UTC now, will report back.

Sam: Dry-run complete in staging: header split applied, no regressions, p99 unchanged, integration smoke OK.

Alex: Great. If wave1 shows anything off we abort wave2 and revert runtime to 2.2.9.

Maria: I'll hold console schema migration until wave2 is green.

Lina: Ops aware? tagging ops-team now.

Ira: ops-team acknowledged and will monitor dashboards.

deploy-bot: Canary wave1 started at 23:00 UTC — id=wave-3612, target 2% traffic.

deploy-bot: Wave1 results (23:06 UTC): api 2% traffic, p99 +0.06ms, errors 0.02% -> PASS.

deploy-bot: Wave2 started at 23:10 UTC — router flag rotated for 2% traffic.

deploy-bot: Wave2 results (23:16 UTC): router steady, no routing loss, PASS.

deploy-bot: Wave3 started at 23:20 UTC — console schema toggle to v5 for 2% users.

deploy-bot: Wave3 results (23:27 UTC): console migrations succeeded on canary, no errors. Full rollout scheduled at 23:40 UTC.

Ira: I'll keep dashboards open for 30m after full rollout.

Alex: Final note — release notes PR: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/1423. If anything spikes during full rollout we abort and follow runbook. Thanks all.
